name: Humuson Complex
legalName: MKM Fertilisers (origin name per About page: "MKM fertilisers was birthed upon realising a gap..."; legal registration not stated on site)
taglines: Home Of Healthy Soil & Healthy Crop
Distributor of organic fertilizers, bio stimulants and foliar fertilizers of renowned European brands
about:
Zimbabwe’s economy is agro-based and its agricultural produce heavily depends on fertilisers for increased crop production. However, the agriculture industry has been heavily dominated by chemical fertilisers which weakened productivity of the soil, hence the need for organic fertilisers to restore the soil among other benefits. MKM fertilisers was birthed upon realising a gap in the inconsistency and inadequate supply of organic fertilisers in Zimbabwe.

Our Vision: To be the preferred supplier of organic fertilizers for the promotion of profitable and sustainable agricultural practices in Zimbabwe and beyond.

Our Mission: To deliver to the Southern African Market high quality fertilizers that maximize crop productivity, improve soil fertility and are eco friendly.
services: Supply of organic fertilizers, biostimulants and foliar fertilizers (Value, Physio & Organic ranges)
